literal: In the waking state / those who do not grant / in the dream / because of seeing / exists / my / life.
translation: My life survives only because I see in my dreams the one who grants me no favor in my waking hours.
modern: நனவில் என் மீது அன்பு காட்டாதவரை நான் கனவில் காண்பதால்தான் என் உயிர் இன்னும் நிலைத்திருக்கிறது.
explanation: The speaker's lover is physically absent and thus unable to show affection in the waking world. However, the lover appears in her dreams, providing the emotional sustenance she needs. The contrast between 'நனவு' (waking) and 'கனவு' (dreaming) highlights that her survival depends entirely on the illusion of the dream. The word 'காண்டலின்' (because of seeing) emphasizes that this mere vision is what keeps her 'உயிர்' (life) from departing.
